```{r}
#| label: setup
if (Sys.getenv("RENV_PROJECT") == "") {
  root <- normalizePath("..", mustWork = TRUE)
  Sys.setenv(RENV_PROJECT = root)
  setwd(root)
  source("renv/activate.R")
}

library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(here)
library(nflverse)
library(gt)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

source(here("R", "viz.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: load_data
trk <- open_dataset(here("data", "processed", "tracking"))
plays <- read_parquet(here("data", "processed", "plays.parquet"))
players <- read_parquet(here("data", "processed", "players.parquet"))
games <- read_parquet(here("data", "processed", "games.parquet"))
```
